messages.subject: Question about congeneric and essentially tau equivalent model in lavaan
parts:
Hello,
I have a question in lavaan package in congenric and tau equivalent model.

This is my code for one factor congeneric model
_________________________________________________________________

Model1 <- ' G_F =~ start(1)*ITEM1 + ITEM2 + ITEM3 + ITEM4 + ITEM5 + ITEM6 + ITEM7 + ITEM8 + ITEM9 +
       ITEM10 + ITEM11 + ITEM12 + ITEM13 + ITEM14 + ITEM15 + ITEM16 + ITEM17 +
       ITEM18 + ITEM19 + ITEM20 + ITEM21 + ITEM22 + ITEM23 + ITEM24 '

fit <- cfa(model1, data = raw.data,meanstructure = TRUE, ordered=c("ITEM1","ITEM2","ITEM3","ITEM4","ITEM5","ITEM6","ITEM7",      
   "ITEM8","ITEM9","ITEM10","ITEM11","ITEM12","ITEM13","ITEM14", 
   "ITEM15","ITEM16","ITEM17","ITEM18","ITEM19","ITEM20","ITEM21",
        "ITEM22","ITEM23","ITEM24"))

______________________________________________________________-

Is it right for one factor congeneric model?
and I want to estimate Residual Variances for ITEM1 ~ 24(it means delta matrix in claasically CFA model).
In addition I just want to constraint off-diagnol 0.
How can I change the code?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Question about congeneric and essentially tau equivalent model in lavaan
parts: Is it right for one factor congeneric model?
and I want to estimate Residual Variances for ITEM1 ~ 24(it means delta matrix in claasically CFA model).

Your indicators are categorical, so those quantities are not estimated.  They are fixed either to 1 (theta parameterization) or to whatever value makes the total variance of the latent item-response 1 (delta parameterization).
In addition I just want to constraint off-diagnol 0.

That  is the default setting.  Residual covariances will only be estimated if you explicitly include them in your model syntax.
